text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)   # was [^a-z0-9] — replaced each char, so runs became "----"
return text.strip("-")                     # was bare `return text` — never stripped edge dashes
```

- `+` makes the regex replace a **run** of non-alphanumerics with a single `-` instead of one dash per character.
- `strip("-")` removes the leading/trailing dashes that edge whitespace/punctuation produces.
